verdict.rationale: Clara documents creating cards via API, with virtual cards active immediately and no activation step (docs-10, docs-11). That supports issuing cards quickly. It also offers per-card restrictions by time, day-of-week and merchant category, plus auto-deletion. However, physical card issuance is only implied by the card-type field, and no per-card spend-limit amount is explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance evidence, documented per-card spend limit amounts, dashboard (non-API) issuance flow for founders, independent corroboration.
